rows.title: Exact: how a kind is created (commands, generators and MCP tools)
rows.summary: Every way to create a declaration of a kind (a use case, an entity, a repository, a model, a controller, a screen...): the `dragonfly make` command that writes its file, the generators that write it finished, and the MCP tools that run them.
body: Every way to create a declaration of a kind (a use case, an entity, a repository, a model, a controller, a screen...): the `dragonfly make` command that writes its file, the generators that write it finished, and the MCP tools that run them.
It reads `commands`, `generator_pieces`, `mcp_tools` of the exact facts; its parameters: `kind` (needed), `platform`.
```text

SELECT 'command' AS how, c.usage AS run, c.does AS writes FROM commands c WHERE c.tool = 'dragonfly' AND c.what = :kind UNION ALL SELECT 'command (any kind)', c.usage, c.does FROM commands c WHERE c.what = 'kind' AND c.usage LIKE 'dragonfly make %' UNION ALL SELECT 'generator on ' || g.platform, g.command, 'writes the ' || g.kind || ' ' || g.name || CASE WHEN g.each != '' THEN ', one per ' || g.each ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN g.condition != '' THEN ' (when ' || g.condition || ')' ELSE '' END FROM generator_pieces g WHERE g.kind = :kind AND (:platform = '' OR g.platform = :platform) UNION ALL SELECT 'MCP tool', t.tool, 'runs `' || t.runs || '`: ' || t.does FROM mcp_tools t WHERE t.runs != '' AND (t.runs = 'dragonfly make ' || :kind OR t.runs IN (SELECT g.command FROM generator_pieces g WHERE g.kind = :kind AND (:platform = '' OR g.platform = :platform)))

que comando sirve para crear un caso de uso
como podria crear un use case
con que comando creo un repositorio

data.sql: SELECT 'command' AS how, c.usage AS run, c.does AS writes FROM commands c WHERE c.tool = 'dragonfly' AND c.what = :kind UNION ALL SELECT 'command (any kind)', c.usage, c.does FROM commands c WHERE c.what = 'kind' AND c.usage LIKE 'dragonfly make %' UNION ALL SELECT 'generator on ' || g.platform, g.command, 'writes the ' || g.kind || ' ' || g.name || CASE WHEN g.each != '' THEN ', one per ' || g.each ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN g.condition != '' THEN ' (when ' || g.condition || ')' ELSE '' END FROM generator_pieces g WHERE g.kind = :kind AND (:platform = '' OR g.platform = :platform) UNION ALL SELECT 'MCP tool', t.tool, 'runs `' || t.runs || '`: ' || t.does FROM mcp_tools t WHERE t.runs != '' AND (t.runs = 'dragonfly make ' || :kind OR t.runs IN (SELECT g.command FROM generator_pieces g WHERE g.kind = :kind AND (:platform = '' OR g.platform = :platform)))

rows.title: Exact: the MCP tools of one group, with their parameters

It reads `mcp_params`, `mcp_tools` of the exact facts; its parameters: `grp` (needed).
```text

SELECT t.tool, t.does, (SELECT group_concat(x.line, ' · ') FROM (SELECT p.name || ': ' || p.type || CASE WHEN p.required = 'true' THEN ' (required)' ELSE ' = ' || p.fallback END AS line FROM mcp_params p WHERE p.tool = t.tool ORDER BY p.n) x) AS parameters, t.runs FROM mcp_tools t WHERE t.grp = :grp ORDER BY t.tool
